title: Item 1 marker extension is test-only — verify_payload_has_no_internal_fields never runs on the production response path
detail: The escaped-marker hardening strengthens a function with zero production call sites — grep shows callers only in server/test/application/application_detail_handler_test.gleam. The detail handler serializes encode_reference_call output straight to the response; the belt-and-braces re-verify never inspects it. SQL-boundary strip still holds (integration-proven), so no live leak.
recommended_fix: Invoke verify_payload_has_no_internal_fields(body) on the serialized detail payload before wisp.json_response (fail closed, 500 on False), or document the guard as test-only.

title: AR-RC13 lint shape-exempts the panel-body substitute construction — its hook gate is not lint-enforced
evidence:
event.on_click(msg.UserChoseRefcheckAction(
              call.reference_call_id,
              RefcheckSubstitute,
            )),

construction (`UserChoseRefcheckAction(..., RefcheckSubstitute)`) are not
legality decisions and are exempt by shape.
detail: The substitute SECTION button constructs the hook-governed affordance via message payload, a shape the lint's `RefcheckSubstitute]` marker never matches. Its legality gate (`case call.hooks.can_substitute_referee` in view_substitute_surface) is code-review-only — a future body-surface re-derivation escapes the CI guard, unlike the overflow-menu shapes the lint does catch (verified empirically).
recommended_fix: Extend lint_refcheck_hooks.py to require UserChoseRefcheckAction constructions of take-over/substitute to sit inside the hook-case-gated render path, or move construction below the gate.
